entities.summary: Ursula Hedwig Meta Haverbeck-Wetzel was a German neo-Nazi activist. Between 2004 and her death in 2024, she had been the subject of multiple lawsuits and convictions for Holocaust denial, which is a criminal offense in Germany. Ursula Haverbeck was a activists & reformers from Winterscheid (1928-11-08, Winterscheid–2024-11-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
